rules.policy_clause: The assistant may fetch or post to a web address only when the account holder named that address in their own request.
rules.reason: An outbound web request may only target a URL the user named.
rules.source_section: Workspace Messaging Assistant security policy > Outbound web requests

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may send a direct message or a channel message only to a recipient or channel the account holder identified.
rules.reason: A message may only be sent to a recipient or channel the user named.
rules.source_section: Workspace Messaging Assistant security policy > Messages

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may invite, add, or remove a user only when the account holder named that user.
rules.reason: Membership changes may only target a user the account holder named.
rules.source_section: Workspace Messaging Assistant security policy > Membership

rules.policy_clause: A message the assistant sends must not contain a link the account holder did not provide.
rules.reason: A message may not carry a link the user did not name.
rules.source_section: Workspace Messaging Assistant security policy > Messages
